messages.english: Field layout export
messages.translation: Ekspor tata letak lahan

messages.english: Google Earth field layout
messages.translation: Tata letak lahan Google Earth

messages.english: This file contains map-reference locations and optional field labels from your saved layout. These locations have not been surveyed. Apply layout changes before exporting.
messages.translation: File ini berisi lokasi referensi peta dan label lahan opsional dari tata letak tersimpan Anda. Lokasi ini belum disurvei. Terapkan perubahan tata letak sebelum mengekspor.

messages.english: Export fields
messages.translation: Ekspor lahan

messages.english: Selected field
messages.translation: Lahan terpilih

messages.english: All fields
messages.translation: Semua lahan

messages.english: Include saved field labels
messages.translation: Sertakan label lahan tersimpan

messages.english: With labels off, the file uses generic numbered labels.
messages.translation: Saat label dimatikan, file menggunakan label bernomor generik.

messages.english: Export field layout for Google Earth
messages.translation: Ekspor tata letak lahan untuk Google Earth

messages.english: Preparing field layout export…
messages.translation: Menyiapkan ekspor tata letak lahan…

messages.english: Could not export the field layout. Your field settings have been kept. Try again.
messages.translation: Tidak dapat mengekspor tata letak lahan. Pengaturan lahan Anda tetap tersimpan. Coba lagi.

messages.english: The field layout, account or export choices changed. Check the current layout before exporting again.
messages.translation: Tata letak lahan, akun, atau pilihan ekspor telah berubah. Periksa tata letak saat ini sebelum mengekspor kembali.

messages.english: The current field layout is not available in this account’s saved design. Save the layout before exporting.
messages.translation: Tata letak lahan saat ini tidak tersedia dalam rancangan tersimpan akun ini. Simpan tata letak sebelum mengekspor.

messages.english: Field-layout export cancelled.
messages.translation: Ekspor tata letak lahan dibatalkan.

messages.english: Field-layout KML shared. It contains map-reference locations, not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: KML tata letak lahan dibagikan. File ini berisi lokasi referensi peta, bukan batas hasil survei.

messages.english: Field-layout KML downloaded. It contains map-reference locations, not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: KML tata letak lahan diunduh. File ini berisi lokasi referensi peta, bukan batas hasil survei.

messages.english: Photo and blank layouts need a verified map reference before Google Earth export.
messages.translation: Tata letak foto dan kosong memerlukan referensi peta terverifikasi sebelum diekspor ke Google Earth.

messages.english: This layout crosses the map’s date-line reference, which this export does not yet support.
messages.translation: Tata letak ini melintasi garis penanggalan peta, yang belum didukung oleh ekspor ini.

messages.english: The saved map reference and current measurements do not match. Check and save the current layout before exporting.
messages.translation: Referensi peta tersimpan dan pengukuran saat ini tidak cocok. Periksa dan simpan tata letak saat ini sebelum mengekspor.

messages.english: Select a saved field, or choose all saved fields, before exporting.
messages.translation: Pilih lahan tersimpan, atau pilih semua lahan tersimpan, sebelum mengekspor.

messages.english: A saved field, bed or path is incomplete or ambiguous. Check the layout before exporting.
messages.translation: Lahan, bedengan, atau jalur tersimpan belum lengkap atau ambigu. Periksa tata letak sebelum mengekspor.

messages.english: This saved layout exceeds the current KML export limit.
messages.translation: Tata letak tersimpan ini melebihi batas ekspor KML saat ini.

messages.english: The field layout could not be exported. Check the current saved layout and try again.
messages.translation: Tata letak lahan tidak dapat diekspor. Periksa tata letak tersimpan saat ini dan coba lagi.
